# Vela

> Vela is a framework (Vela.Plugins and Vela.Messages, .NET Framework 4.6.2, for plugins on 4.6.2 through 4.8), a CLI (Vela.Cli, command `vela`) and an in-memory test harness (Vela.Testing) for Microsoft Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs, with a preview-first `vela plan` then `vela apply` workflow. Steps are declared in code with a type-state fluent builder; 27 Roslyn analyzers (VELA001 to VELA028, VELA006 retired), bundled in Vela.Plugins, reject invalid registrations at build time.

Key facts: plugin classes are `sealed partial` with a primary constructor `(string unsecureConfig, string secureConfig)`; Create, Update, CreateMultiple and UpdateMultiple steps require `FilterOn(...)`; the handler context exposes `ctx.Service`, `ctx.SystemService` and `ctx.AsUser(id)`; typed reads are `service.Retrieve<T>(id, a => a.Col)`, `RetrieveByKey` and `Query.For<T>()`; `vela plan` and `vela apply` require `--solution <uniquename>` (one existing unmanaged solution per run) and `vela add customapi` requires `--prefix <publisherprefix>`; `vela plan --json` and `vela help --json` are machine-readable. A project scaffolded by `vela init` has its own AGENTS.md, and a PROJECT.md that records those values (the CLI never reads it: pass them as flags).

## Getting started

- [Install](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/getting-started/install.md): Install the vela CLI and the prerequisites: the .NET 10 SDK, Mono for .NET Framework tests outside Windows, an existing unmanaged solution
- [Quickstart](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/getting-started/quickstart.md): From an empty folder to a tested, registered plugin: install, init, models, add, build and test, plan, apply
- [Initialize a solution](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/getting-started/initialize-a-solution.md): What vela init scaffolds and where to edit

## Guides: Build plugins

- [Write a plugin](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/plugins.md): The step builder: typed triggers, stages, modes, FilterOn, images, several steps per class, typed handler contexts, context helpers, errors, tracing and the sandbox rules
- [Write a Custom API](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/custom-apis.md): Typed request and response, parameters (required by default), binding, the rules Build() enforces, and changing a deployed Custom API
- [Typed queries](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/queries.md): Typed QueryExpression and FetchXML with Query.For<T>(), and typed reads of one record with service.Retrieve<T>(id, a => a.Col) and RetrieveByKey
- [Dependency injection](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/dependency-injection.md): The sandbox-safe container: registration, lifetimes, the built-in services and the user a service runs as
- [Escape hatches](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/escape-hatches.md): Drop to the raw Dataverse SDK, read or create a record with its related records

## Guides: Built-in services

- [Caching](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/caching.md): A TTL cache scoped per organization: what is safe to cache and how to test a TTL
- [Environment variables](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/environment-variables.md): Read Dataverse environment variables, typed, with a missing-value policy and optional caching
- [Localized messages](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/localization.md): Resolve messages in the user's or the organization's language
- [Managed identity](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/managed-identity.md): Call external APIs with a managed-identity token, link the plugin package to the identity, and test it
- [Telemetry and Application Insights](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/telemetry.md): Leveled, structured telemetry to the trace log and Application Insights through the platform logger

## Guides: Test

- [Testing](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/testing.md): PluginPipeline runs the Dataverse pipeline in memory: registered steps, cascades, transactions and Custom APIs
- [Security model in tests](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/security-model.md): Opt-in security in the in-memory service: roles, privileges, business units, teams, sharing

## Guides: CLI and deployment

- [The vela CLI](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/cli-overview.md): Commands, generated help, option syntax, exit codes, proxy, solution prefix (vela solution show), execution logs (vela logs)
- [Scaffold a solution (vela init)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/scaffold.md): Every vela init option, the generated layout, the optional projects, samples and PROJECT.md
- [Add a component (vela add)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/add.md): Generate a plugin, service, Custom API or test file, or add a step to an existing plugin
- [Early-bound models (vela models)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/models.md): Typed table, Custom API and SDK message classes, security roles, drift checks, offline generation, TypeScript form and table types (preview)
- [Plan and apply](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/plan-apply.md): Preview then apply registrations: --solution (an unmanaged solution), secure config, batched writes, resuming a failed apply, CI usage
- [Sign the plugin package (vela sign)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/signing.md): Sign a plugin package for managed identity
- [Client-side (preview)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/client-side.md): TypeScript form scripts and web resources (preview, work in progress)

## Guides: Examples and troubleshooting

- [End-to-end example](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/end-to-end.md): One plugin from code to a running step: write, test, build, plan, apply, read its trace
- [Cookbook](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/cookbook.md): Short recipes for the most common patterns
- [Migrating an existing project](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/migrating.md): Move an existing plugin or workflow-activity project to Vela
- [Troubleshooting](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/troubleshooting.md): Fixes for common errors, in the order you meet them

- [Environments and CI](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/configuration/environments-secrets.md): Run the CLI unattended: passing secrets, strict mode, output in pipelines

## AI layer: Get started

- [Overview](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/overview.md): What Vela Agentic is, what it does, and what it never does
- [Install](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/install.md): Install the pack in Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI, and the tools it needs

## AI layer: How it works

- [The build loop](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/build-loop.md): The steps from a user story to the deploy gate, with the Vela Canvas, the rules registry and the Build Report
- [Project files](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/project-files.md): The files Vela Agentic reads and writes in your project: PROJECT.md, docs/features, docs/rules, docs/adr and .vela-runs
- [The deploy guard (hooks)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/hooks.md): The optional host hook that blocks vela apply without approval, edits to generated files, protected pushes and secrets

## AI layer: Agents

- [vela-builder](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/vela-builder.md): The vela-builder agent: drives a user story through the build loop and stops at the apply gate
- [vela-reviewer](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/vela-reviewer.md): The vela-reviewer agent: an isolated, read-only review of a plugin change on spec and standards

## AI layer: Skills

- [All skills](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/index.md): The 11 skills of Vela Agentic, when each one triggers and the step of the build loop it covers
- [using-vela](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/using-vela.md): The using-vela skill: the entry point that maps the build loop to the other skills
- [vela-plan-review](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-plan-review.md): The vela-plan-review skill: challenges the plan, writes the rules and fills the Vela Canvas before any code
- [vela-grill](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-grill.md): The vela-grill skill: interviews the human to resolve an ambiguous story before building
- [vela-scaffold](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-scaffold.md): The vela-scaffold skill: creates a solution with vela init and components with vela add
- [vela-models](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-models.md): The vela-models skill: generates typed models from the org, checks them for drift, and generates role classes
- [vela-plugin-testing](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-plugin-testing.md): The vela-plugin-testing skill: failing tests first with PluginPipeline, full coverage of the acceptance cases
- [vela-plugin-authoring](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-plugin-authoring.md): The vela-plugin-authoring skill: implements the plugin logic until the failing tests pass
- [vela-custom-api](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-custom-api.md): The vela-custom-api skill: designs, tests and implements a Custom API through the same build loop
- [vela-code-review](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-code-review.md): The vela-code-review skill: spec-check, then an isolated review on spec and standards before the apply gate
- [vela-apply](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-apply.md): The vela-apply skill: packages, signs if needed, previews with vela plan and stops at the apply gate
- [vela-debug-plugin](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/skills/vela-debug-plugin.md): The vela-debug-plugin skill: reproduces a plugin fault as a failing test before any fix

## AI layer: Reference

- [How the pack is tested](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/testing-the-pack.md): How the skills are tested: pressure scenarios with hidden criteria, deterministic checks, a separate grader and mutation
- [FAQ and troubleshooting](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/ai-layer/faq.md): Short answers to common questions about running Vela Agentic, and what to do when a run stops
